key_idea: Simulate the left-hand rule literally and stop when a (cell, direction) state repeats.
sketch: State is (row, col, facing) with at most 50*50*4 values. Each step: if the cell to the left is in bounds and empty turn left and move, else if the cell ahead is empty move, else turn right. Reaching the target prints 1; revisiting a state means a cycle, print 0. Pitfalls: out-of-bounds counts as blocked, start faces right, and rows grow downward so 'left' of right is up.
